# Braking distance

<!-- STEP id="slow" -->
Use v² = u² + 2as with v = 0 and a = -4 m/s². This gives s = u² / 8.

At 54 km/h = 15 m/s: s = 225 / 8 = 28.1 m.

<!-- STEP id="fast" -->
At 108 km/h = 30 m/s: s = 900 / 8 = 112.5 m.

**Double the speed gives four times the braking distance.**
